body:
Track 11 milestone 2 (`mimic-loop`): prompt-only imitation game with Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct as imitator and detector, four proposers (random, GA, GrIPS-style, local-LLM) at equal budget on two families. Honest weak result: baseline detector starts below chance, proposers can't be ranked at 24 test pairs / one seed, length is a major confound. 17 unit tests pass (stub model), `python3 site/build.py` prints ok, README + homepage entry + run record included. Results re-run with `./run_all.sh` (~3.5 h CPU).
